banner.title: About Us
banner.text: Panoramia Capital is a Real Estate Development and Investment company with 40+ years of experience in conceiving and developing urban, residential, logistics warehouses complex and commercial projects. Panoramia experience and track record has been concentrated in Caracas, Venezuela.
banner.imageAlt: View of Caracas and El Ávila

approach.title: Panoramia Capital
approach.text1: Is composed of a group of professionals with vast experience in real estate development, real estate fundraising, designing, construction, and sales. Panoramia Capital has concentrated on integrating all aspects a development requires and focused on working on its own projects. Creating value in the conception, and execution rather than in rendering service to third parties.
approach.text2: We invest in the projects we put our minds and work into and partner with local and foreign limited partners in each project. Throughout the past years, Panoramia has acquired and holds a large bank of land, strategically located in Caracas. Panoramia has developed significantly large projects, with significant amounts of investment.

competitiveAdvantage.title: Competitive Advantage
competitiveAdvantage.text1: Panoramia Capital’s competitive edge lies in its vast experience in Venezuela, a comprehensive team of professionals covering every aspect of the project from identifying the opportunity to completion, its significant bank of prime located land in Caracas, and the fact that we act as the General Partner and co-invest significantly in all of our developments.
competitiveAdvantage.text2: Panoramia Capital and its executive board have together urbanized more than 200 hectares in Caracas, built more than 7,500 apartments for the middle-income segment and some for top-tier buyers, and have developed +70,000 sqm of warehouses and shopping centers among other developments.
competitiveAdvantage.text3: Panoramia Capital owners and managing directors have a recognized track record locally of initiative, market knowledge and transparency among the Venezuelan real estate and financial sector.

banner.title: Track Record
banner.text: Four decades of projects conceived, built, and delivered across Caracas.
banner.imageAlt: Aerial view of Caracas urban development

marketOpportunities.title: Market Opportunities
marketOpportunities.text: Panoramia Capital is constantly evaluating opportunities in different sub-sectors of the real estate industry in Venezuela. Although traditional sub-sectors are currently under significant stress from a business and commercial standpoint, there are niche sub-sectors that present opportunities for different reasons — such as location, modernity in technological updates, changes in consumers’ shopping patterns and habits, as well as those that open up due to changes in the macroeconomic development of Venezuela and its main industries.

banner.text: Panoramia controls a vast extension of raw terrain located in Caracas and within the expansion area of the city.

competitiveAdvantage.title: Key Competitive Advantage
competitiveAdvantage.text: Panoramia’s land holdings enable the company to develop its own projects across multiple use categories, controlling the full value chain from raw land to finished development.
competitiveAdvantage.strongText: This vertical integration reduces dependency on third-party landowners and maximizes returns at every stage of the development cycle.

strategicPositioning.title: Caracas Metropolitan Area
strategicPositioning.imageAlt: Satellite view of Greater Caracas with Panoramia land holdings reach overlays
strategicPositioning.text1: Satellite view of the Greater Caracas area, spanning from Catia in the west to Petare in the east — the city’s full urban corridor along the Guaire valley.
strategicPositioning.text2: El Encantado, marked on the map, sits at a key inflection point at the southeastern edge of the metropolitan area, where the city transitions into the expansion zone toward the Tuy valleys.
strategicPositioning.text3: The quarter-circle overlays illustrate the reach of Panoramia’s land holdings:

banner.title: Current Projects
banner.text: Consumers’ shopping expectations have changed and they want and expect their needs to be satisfied immediately, effortlessly, and affordably.

microFulfillment.title: Micro Fulfillment Centers and Last-Mile Warehousing

consumerShift.title: Consumer Shift
consumerShift.text: Modern shoppers demand immediate, effortless, and affordable same-day delivery as a standard requirement.

disintermediation.title: Disintermediation
disintermediation.text: Distributors are increasingly utilizing direct-to-consumer (D2C) models via social networks, bypassing traditional retail to optimize costs and inventory control.

operationalIntelligence.title: Operational Intelligence
operationalIntelligence.text: Integrating Warehouse Management Systems (WMS) and data analytics enables predictive demand modeling, providing a competitive advantage over legacy logistic platforms.

urbanInfrastructure.title: Urban Infrastructure

estanciasLosBufalos.imageAlt: Estancias Los Bufalos equestrian community development
estanciasLosBufalos.text1: Estancias Los Bufalos is an urban development designed as an equestrian community especially for people who want to have a country house in the city and to those that practice horseback riding and team penning.
estanciasLosBufalos.text2: It consists of 70+ parcels of land of approximately 5,000 sqm located in a beautiful hill out looking to the south of Caracas. All circled with horse riding ways and a fully equipped equestrian club with courts, stables, and further facilities.
